title: Gulp City
description: You are a tiny black hole loose in a huge 3D city! Swallow fire hydrants, cones and benches, then grow big enough for cars, fire trucks and buses, then whole houses, skyscrapers and the stadium. Watch out for the other black holes: they grow too, and a bigger one can swallow you.
notes: Official game, rebuilt from the admin's Builder idea (a black hole eating a city, other black holes that can eat you, a super expansive map). 3D with the built-in Three.js 0.185.1 (pinned import map with integrity), no Oomba Kit (docs/decisions.md "3D worlds are the Builder's own"): its own title, how-to-play, settings (sound, music, read aloud, motion, high contrast, text size), pause, swallowed and results screens in 13 languages (RTL for Arabic and Hebrew), light and dark. The city is generated from a fixed seed: an island of 24 x 24 blocks (1.4 km across) with downtown skyscrapers, midtown apartments and shops, suburbs of houses, parks, a big park with a ferris wheel, a harbour with cranes, containers and boats, a stadium and the Gulp Tower in the central plaza; about 31,000 things in 39 kinds plus about 260 cars, taxis, buses, vans and trucks driving the streets. Things are instanced per kind per 100 m region, hidden when too small to see at the camera's distance; the ground is one shader (roads, lanes, crossings, sidewalks, grass, docks, the sea). A hole is a stencil disc that cuts the ground away, a pit with a swirl at the bottom and a glowing rim; things that fit (their footprint under 92% of the hole's radius) tip in, sink and shrink, and grow the hole (area adds up, slowing as it gets big). Eight size groups unlock with a banner (hydrants and lamp posts, benches/bikes/trees, cars and fountains, vans and fire trucks, buses and houses, buildings, skyscrapers, landmarks and the stadium). Rivals (6/8/10 for easy/normal/hard, 'Zorp', 'Bloop'...) seek food, chase smaller holes for a few seconds, flee bigger ones; a hole 15% bigger swallows a smaller one whose middle it covers; the player is safe for 22 s at the start and 3 s after a respawn, and starts again a bit smaller ('Gulp!' card). Play: 2½-minute round, ranked by size, 1-3 stars, BRB.gameOver({ won: rank 1, score: points }); Free roam: no clock, 'See results' from the pause menu (BRB.score.submit). Saves best points and size in 'gulp-city-v1' and settings in 'gulp-city-settings'. Buildings between the camera and the player turn to a see-through lattice. No people are ever swallowed. Test hooks: window.__brbTest (state, start, drive, teleport, setSize, nearest, objectState, types, rival, freezeRivals, setGrace, setTimeLeft, sim, autopilot, keepGoing, pause, resume, finish, menu, cover).

pt.description: Você é um buraco negro pequenininho solto numa enorme cidade 3D! Engula hidrantes, cones e bancos, cresça até poder engolir carros, caminhões de bombeiro e ônibus, depois casas inteiras, arranha-céus e o estádio. Cuidado com os outros buracos negros: eles também crescem, e um maior pode engolir você.

fr.description: Tu es un tout petit trou noir lâché dans une immense ville en 3D ! Avale les bouches d’incendie, les cônes et les bancs, grandis jusqu’à pouvoir avaler les voitures, les camions de pompiers et les bus, puis des maisons entières, des gratte-ciel et le stade. Attention aux autres trous noirs : eux aussi grandissent, et un plus grand peut t’avaler.

es.description: ¡Eres un agujero negro diminuto suelto en una enorme ciudad en 3D! Trágate bocas de incendio, conos y bancos, crece hasta poder tragarte coches, camiones de bomberos y autobuses, y luego casas enteras, rascacielos y el estadio. Cuidado con los otros agujeros negros: también crecen, y uno más grande puede tragarte.

de.description: Du bist ein winziges Schwarzes Loch in einer riesigen 3D-Stadt! Verschling Hydranten, Hütchen und Bänke, wachse, bis du Autos, Feuerwehrautos und Busse schaffst, dann ganze Häuser, Wolkenkratzer und das Stadion. Pass auf die anderen Schwarzen Löcher auf: Sie wachsen auch, und ein größeres kann dich verschlingen.

he.description: אתם חור שחור קטנטן בעיר תלת־ממדית ענקית! בלעו ברזי כיבוי, קונוסים וספסלים, גדלו עד שתוכלו לבלוע מכוניות, כבאיות ואוטובוסים, ואז בתים שלמים, גורדי שחקים ואת האצטדיון. היזהרו מהחורים השחורים האחרים: גם הם גדלים, וחור גדול יותר יכול לבלוע אתכם.

ja.description: きみは おおきな 3Dの まちに いる ちいさな ブラックホール！しょうかせんや コーン、ベンチを のみこんで、くるまや しょうぼうしゃ、バスを のみこめるまで おおきく なろう。さいごは いえや こうそうビル、スタジアムまで！ほかの ブラックホールに ちゅうい。あいても おおきく なって、おおきい あなは きみを のみこめるよ。
ja.tags: 3D,ブラックホール,まち,のみこむ,おおきくなる,アーケード,ライバル,こうそうビル,オープンワールド

ar.description: أنت ثقب أسود صغير جدًا في مدينة ضخمة ثلاثية الأبعاد! ابتلع صنابير الإطفاء والأقماع والمقاعد، واكبر حتى تبتلع السيارات وسيارات الإطفاء والحافلات، ثم بيوتًا كاملة وناطحات سحاب والملعب. احذر الثقوب السوداء الأخرى: إنها تكبر أيضًا، والأكبر منك يستطيع ابتلاعك.

ru.description: Ты крошечная чёрная дыра в огромном 3D-городе! Глотай гидранты, конусы и скамейки, расти, пока не сможешь проглотить машины, пожарные машины и автобусы, а потом целые дома, небоскрёбы и стадион. Берегись других чёрных дыр: они тоже растут, и дыра побольше может проглотить тебя.

it.description: Sei un minuscolo buco nero in un’enorme città in 3D! Inghiotti idranti, coni e panchine, cresci finché puoi inghiottire auto, camion dei pompieri e autobus, poi case intere, grattacieli e lo stadio. Attento agli altri buchi neri: crescono anche loro, e uno più grande può inghiottirti.

zh-Hant.description: 你是一個在超大 3D 城市裡的小小黑洞！吞下消防栓、三角錐和長椅，長大到能吞下汽車、消防車和公車，最後連整棟房子、摩天大樓和體育場都吞下去。小心其他黑洞：它們也會長大，比你大的黑洞可以把你吞掉。
zh-Hant.tags: 3D,黑洞,城市,吞下,長大,街機,對手,摩天大樓,開放世界

nl.description: Jij bent een piepklein zwart gat in een enorme 3D-stad! Slok brandkranen, pionnen en bankjes op, groei tot je auto’s, brandweerauto’s en bussen aankunt, en daarna hele huizen, wolkenkrabbers en het stadion. Pas op voor de andere zwarte gaten: die groeien ook, en een groter gat kan jou opslokken.
